notes_for_ai.barcode_handling: scRNA-seq barcodes often have batch suffixes (e.g., -1-0-1) that must be normalized to barcode_core, but barcode_core must never be used without sample_id
notes_for_ai.sample_naming: TCR and scRNA-seq samples may have different naming conventions even within the same GSE. Always use the mapping table.
notes_for_ai.null_values: Missing TCR chains are represented as empty strings, not NaN or None
notes_for_ai.one_to_many: Some scRNA-seq samples may map to multiple TCR samples (or vice versa). Check mapping_type column.
notes_for_ai.sop: Canonical SOP: parse raw contigs, build one canonical per-cell TCR table, join by sample_id plus barcode_core, replace stale TCR fields, then validate before propagation.
notes_for_ai.historical_warning: Earlier barcode-only or barcode-prefix-only joins can create false paired TRA/TRB inflation when core barcodes recur across samples.
